values.value: Verified against the official Salesforce Help exam guide (article 005387657, aligned to the Summer '26 release): 60 multiple-choice questions plus up to 5 unscored, 105 minutes, 72% passing score, no prerequisite. Section weights are Campaign Design Flow Orchestration and Content 30%, Data Modeling Identity Resolution and Segmentation 25%, Platform Setup and Governance 13%, Consent 13%, Agentforce and AI Innovation 11%, Analytics and Performance Insights 8%. Agrees with docs/assets/examfacts.js.
